inputs.preparation: Use complete canonical apo monomers identified in brief; relabel receptor R and ligand L and serialize; introduce no new residue or atom selection. References restricted to evaluation.

outputs.docking: Per case and configuration, ranked transform/score output and exactly 50 ranked complex PDBs; 600 PDBs per complete three-configuration pass, excluding repetitions.
outputs.evaluation: Per-decoy DockQ; per-case DockQ at rank 1 and maximum over ranks 1..50, reported separately. Also per-case speed, CPU/GPU agreement, workflow time, GPU activity, billed allocation cost, errors and overruns.

scoring_interface.layout: eval_dir/<configuration>/<system_id>/apo_decoys/model_<rank>.pdb; exactly R and L chains. Evaluate only four selected cases, not entire test set.
scoring_interface.subset_handling: Published --custom_index requires full PINDER index schema with test holdout fields. Preserve original selected rows and scope evaluation to four-case subset. Do not penalize absent unselected cases.
scoring_interface.complex_assembly: Published decoygen produces transformed ligand; combine with unchanged receptor and preserve R/L labels.

timing_scope.workflow: Report input acquisition/preparation, setup, docking, pose serialization, evaluation and telemetry/aggregation separately and complete elapsed workflow time; also isolate docking execution for acceleration comparison.
timing_scope.gpu_activity: Collect GPU activity over timed allocations; collector and sampling interval unavailable until runtime environment inspected.
timing_scope.billed_allocation_cost: Use actual billed allocation duration and provider rate; price, billing granularity and currency unavailable in brief.
timing_scope.calibration: One bounded runtime calibration at fixed four-case scientific scale before sealing repetitions, comparisons and spending cap. Intake ran no workload.
timing_scope.budgets: No stage estimates or overrides supplied; use pipeline defaults and run ceiling from prompt; runtime completion cannot be established without calibration.

repeatability.timing_repetitions_reason: Brief requires calibration then sealing; intake does not run workloads.
repeatability.tolerance_reason: No published tolerance established for this comparison. Must justify and seal numerical tolerances before comparative results; not an anchor gate.
repeatability.comparison_rules: Separate CPU/GPU equal-sampling execution speed and agreement from GPU dense-versus-standard DockQ changes; report top-ranked and best of 50 separately for every case. Preserve failures and budget overruns.
repeatability.spending_cap_reason: Brief requires calibration and sealed cap; no allocation price or calibrated runtime supplied.
repeatability.seeds_reason: No seed or randomized trial policy supplied; published fixed rotational enumeration used.
repeatability.thread_count_reason: Must seal after environment inspection; do not import FroDock run9 eight-rank configuration.

contract_limitations: Intake summary exposes availability, licence and feasibility, not three separate scientific conclusions or per-case two-endpoint quality comparisons. Rich execution/evaluation artifacts are required.

anchors.json supports independently published scalar criteria or references; it cannot represent an uncalibrated paired CPU/GPU agreement rule or dense-search improvement hypothesis for these four cases. Do not convert local agreement checks into published anchors.

Fixed workload is pinned, but repetition count, justified numerical agreement tolerances and total spending cap remain unsealed pending authorized later calibration. No scientific evaluation should precede sealing.
